panels.rationale: Video capsule endoscopy (PillCam SB3) from a patient with Heyde's syndrome; the caption shows small bleeding ulcers in the distal small intestine with visible flat erythematous/arborizing vascular mucosa consistent with an angiodysplastic substrate. Ulcers are not a vocabulary finding, so they are recorded as a proposed finding; attribution to gastrointestinal angiodysplasia is supported by the article's focus and the visual vascular ectasia, giving moderate confidence.
